title: IFCS1-IBANK: saturated cap-limited source with linear classical bits and fresh-input-charged full bank clears

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1-IBANK implementation of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1S2332 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, extraction/merge failures, rejected/discarded sources, fallback/source aborts, initialization and cleanup. Fully charged time is O(2^((47/25)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Known-index measured basis operations use a fully counted BIG/SMALL layout. BIG regions are FULLY cleared on allocation/free; inner row/bit/heap/gate helpers reuse existing BIG arrays and polynomial SMALL. Disjoint fresh inputs at each fixed height bound all BIG scopes by O(n*(Qcap+1)), including a final unfinished abort path. Full cost is poly(n)*(T_P+B*(Qcap+1)+Ssmall+H+1),T_P=O(n^(9/2)*2^(tau0*sqrt n)),Qcap=O(n^2*2^(H0*sqrt n)),B=O(n^5*2^(mu0*sqrt n)). Exact tau0=3240574229/1724880000,H0=1724835929/1724880000,mu0=7187/10000,d0=703/800 satisfy tau0=H0+d0, d0-mu0=3201/20000>0 and tau0<47/25. Thus every full clear fits and all remaining polynomial work is absorbed by strict rational gaps. No free QRAM, lazy epoch counter or extra failure guard is assumed.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1-IBANK implementation of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1S2332 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, extraction/merge failures, rejected/discarded sources, fallback/source aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak ordinary classical workspace is O(n) bits, exact growth index0. Count input/output, constant-many O(n)-bit staged operands/physical addresses/current-frame fields, finite control and reusable bits/indices. Every source table/heap/list, return frame, numerical scratch, LE/profile/decoder/generator record and allocator state is counted basis memory in BIG or polynomial SMALL. Long scratch is streamed, not staged as ordinary arrays. No physical classical recursion stack, large directory or growing transcript exists. The complete fixed maximum spans give O(n)-bit addresses, jointly with success and all other bounds.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1-IBANK implementation of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1S2332 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, extraction/merge failures, rejected/discarded sources, fallback/source aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak FULL allocated quantum workspace is O(2^((23/32)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Entire fixed owners A=2^16*n^2,rows R=2^(Lam+kappa+16),row bits Wrow=2^16*n^2 give B=2^48*n^4*2^(Lam+kappa). Source Lam=kappa+1+w_s,2^kappa<=32sqrt n,2^w_s<2*2^(mu0*sqrt n),mu0=7187/10000 imply B=O(n^5*2^(mu0*sqrt n)). Exact gap23/32-mu0=1/20000 absorbs all polynomial factors into the pure target. Polynomial SMALL/H, metadata, free flags, all active/inactive owner/row/field/prefix padding, original coherent registers and source temporaries are counted in the complete rounded paired prefix. This is a maximum-address bound independent of lifetime or labels, not occupancy. All full clears and serial coherent lookup gates are charged; no coherent bank oracle is used.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1-IBANK implementation of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1S2332 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, extraction/merge failures, rejected/discarded sources, fallback/source aborts, initialization and cleanup. All acquired DCP copies number O(2^(sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Exactly one physical request executes each P request and no others. Literal unchanged Qcap=1024*(6*2^hmax*(kappa+1+nu)*((J+1)*K+2a2)+2a2) includes every rejection, failed/discarded input, source/fallback abort and both full-secret recovery stages. Full reference proves Qcap=O(n^2*2^(H0*sqrt n)),H0=1724835929/1724880000<1. Its separate exact positive gap absorbs n^2 into the pure envelope. Fresh zero bank/padding, complete BIG/SMALL clears and source moves use charged gates/storage rather than additional copies. Source precision/caps and finite tester remain unchanged.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1-IBANK implementation of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1S2332 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, extraction/merge failures, rejected/discarded sources, fallback/source aborts, initialization and cleanup. Guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. The measured basis interpreter preserves the decoded correlated-CQ state, irreversible forgetting, allocation/free/reset, full original quantum instruments and complete source/output law with arbitrary references. Extra helper outcomes are marginalized rather than added to inherited held-out-bit conditioning. No positive robustness, transfer to another adaptive supplier model or impossibility of greater robustness is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
